EnricoMonese/DayNightCycle reference notice
===========================================

Project: DayNightCycle
Author: Enrico Monese
Source: https://github.com/EnricoMonese/DayNightCycle
License: MIT
Copyright (c) 2020 Enrico Monese

CELESTIAL06 uses the reference project's core control architecture: a single
normalized Sun/up dot drives lighting, ambient, atmosphere and colour curves.
Heritage does not compile or embed the Unity C# component. The behavior is a
native C++/GLSL adaptation integrated with Heritage's astronomical Sun/Moon,
physical atmosphere, regional weather and cloud renderer.
